chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar, from Abū Ḥabīb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with a woman while she is menstruating.
He said: “He must pay one dīnār at the beginning of menstruation, and half a dīnār at its end.”

He said: I said, “May I be made your ransom, is anything from the hadd punishment obligatory upon him?” He said: “Yes, twenty-five lashes, one quarter of the hadd of the fornicator, because he committed illicit intercourse.”

key_terms.اسْتِدْبَارِهِ: the latter phase or end of menstruation
key_terms.حَائِضٌ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.حَدِّ الزَّانِي: the legal punishment of the fornicator

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating in Shiʿi hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intercourse with a menstruating woman, specifying an expiation that differs according to the stage of menstruation. It also states a disciplinary punishment, indicating the gravity of the prohibited act in Shiʿi fiqh.
